style="rounded=1;whiteSpace=wrap;html=1;arcSize=6;fillColor=#FFFFFF;strokeColor=#B8BFB9;fontColor=#14201C;fontSize=11;align=left;verticalAlign=top;spacing=8;fontFamily=Helvetica;fontSize=12;" value="<b>How to read this</b><br>1 The analyst signs in with Firebase Authentication; a new user first creates a workspace (free trial).<br>2 The SPA calls kredibel-web with a verified ID token; it checks the plan, splits uploads into pages and starts a run.<br>3 kredibel-web enqueues one Cloud Task per run, named run-{runId}, so a double click cannot start two runs.<br>4 Cloud Tasks pushes the task to kredibel-worker with an OIDC token; only that service account may invoke it.<br>5 The ADK workflow has Gemini read every page image (5a); the PDF text layer, or Document AI OCR for scans (5b), is the independent witness. Then it checks, scores, suggests profile details and drafts the memo.<br>6 Results and progress land in Firestore; the browser listens read-only and fetches data through the API.<br>Not drawn: kredibel-web also calls Gemini and Agent Platform Sessions for the case assistant (P1). All writes go through the API; Firestore rules deny client writes. Logs carry IDs only, never document text." vertex="1"> <mxGeometry height="150" width="1240" x="300" y="730" as="geometry" /> </mxCell> </root> </mxGraphModel> </diagram> </mxfile>

div.div:
How to read this
1 The analyst signs in with Firebase Authentication; a new user first creates a workspace (free trial).
2 The SPA calls kredibel-web with a verified ID token; it checks the plan, splits uploads into pages and starts a run.
3 kredibel-web enqueues one Cloud Task per run, named run-{runId}, so a double click cannot start two runs.
4 Cloud Tasks pushes the task to kredibel-worker with an OIDC token; only that service account may invoke it.
5 The ADK workflow has Gemini read every page image (5a); the PDF text layer, or Document AI OCR for scans (5b), is the independent witness. Then it checks, scores, suggests profile details and drafts the memo.
6 Results and progress land in Firestore; the browser listens read-only and fetches data through the API.
Not drawn: kredibel-web also calls Gemini and Agent Platform Sessions for the case assistant (P1). All writes go through the API; Firestore rules deny client writes. Logs carry IDs only, never document text.
